name: STAR CCSDS — Space Packet build, read and split
summary: CCSDS Space Packet primary header and packet boundary (CCSDS 133.0-B-2): encode and decode the six header fields, build and read whole packets, split a stream, advance the sequence count; every field checked, nothing masked, a truncated packet refused with the octet where the stream breaks; identical to spacepackets and ccsdspy on 1483 cases.
reference: CCSDS 133.0-B-2, section 4.1.3, written out by hand: telemetry, secondary header, APID 0x123, unsegmented, count 42, two data octets -> 09 23 C0 2A 00 01; idle packet of one octet -> 07 FF C0 00 00 00

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: encode_header(), decode_header(), encode_packet(), decode_packet(), split_packets(), next_count()
review.G-04: octets most significant bit first; the length field is the number of data octets minus one
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO, no state
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; a stream with a damaged length field is refused, not resynchronised, stated in the README
